Hi, and welcome! I'm Oleksandr, and I build Rolebranch. This is where you can learn it, ask about
it, and tell me what to build and what to fix. I read every post.

## Where to post

- 📣 **[Announcements](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/announcements)**: step-by-step guides (titled "📖 Guide") and news on what shipped. Comment on a guide if a step doesn't match what you see.
- 🙏 **[Q&A](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/q-a)**: "How do I…?", or something that doesn't work as it should. When a reply solves it, choose **Mark as answer**.
- 💡 **[Ideas](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/ideas)**: something new you'd like. Upvote 👍 the ideas you want: it's how I decide what comes next.
- 🗳️ **[Polls](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/polls)**: vote on what comes next.
- 🙌 **[Show and tell](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)**: the interview you landed, a template you styled, a tip that worked.
- 💬 **[General](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/categories/general)**: anything else about job searching.

## One thing to remember

These discussions are **public**. Please don't post your CV, your contact details or screenshots
that show them. If I need something private to sort out a problem, I'll ask you to send it through
[rolebranch.com/help/request](https://rolebranch.com/help/request).

## New here?

Rolebranch is free during the beta: 100 welcome credits that never expire, plus 50 every month, no
card. Start with [Import your first CV](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/import-your-first-cv),
then add a job you want and let Romy tailor a copy.

Say hi below: what kind of role are you looking for? 👇
